text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All right, time to train!
Everyone, keep up with Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The effect of gaining new companions showed immediately.
Twin Turbo was no longer overly frightened of other Umamusume, and...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha☆ Wanna do a mock race then?
I'm gonna burst out with a super runaway lead right off the bat★彡

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm not losing to you, Helios!
I'm gonna pull off an explosive breakaway too!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I will adapt to the race development.
Leading the pack is fine. Coming from behind is fine too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, maybe I should just hold back in the rear.
I'm still in the Junior Class, so I'll just take whatever I can get if the seniors up front crumble.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see.
Then Turbo will...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Just win!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Think about it a little, at least!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so begins the practice race.
However, once major issues like "gate phobia"
and "timidity" are resolved...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: See ya ahead!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huh? Huh? Wait, wait, wait, whaaat~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Now, the reality of Twin Turbo's current level of ability was beginning to show."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Oryo? Where's Turbo...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Look, over there.
Right by the goal post, someone tripped and...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: *gasp*, *wheeze*, *pant*~

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Of course... I'm fine...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo isn't—Turbo hasn't burned out yet! That last one was just a fluke!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She rises once more with an indomitable, spirited soul.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I won't let you pass me this time! Pass me...
Gwaaaaaaaaaagh?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I trained with everything I had!
So... so why...! Aaaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Brain cells, explode! Today I'm making a comeback from behind... Waaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, wheeze*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how hard she tried or struggled desperately,
Twin Turbo just couldn't win.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She could hardly ever finish ahead of her classmate Nice Nature. In both ability and conditioning, she certainly fell short.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: U-Uuu, uuuuugh...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
No, no, nooooo!
Turbo's trying her best!
And yet it's still... not enough at aaaaall!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's so unfair~~~! This is totally
cheating! Waaaahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah, Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: Think you can leave it to me for a while?
Could you leave things to me for a while?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Anything we say right now
would probably just hurt them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series never goes entirely as planned.
And that didn't just apply to Twin Turbo.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Then Tokai Teio isn't
doing well?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I hear her debut date
is still nowhere in sight.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If we're aiming for the Classic Triple Crown, I'd prefer to at least have your Make Debut out of the way soon.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rumors swirl through Tracen Academy.
Ahead of next spring's first Triple Crown race...
dark clouds gather over Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, Teio~~~!!
Tokai Teio~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Catching wind of that,
a little bullet shot across the academy.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: One, two, one, two, and...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Teio!!
Tokai Teio!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What is it? Um...
It was Twin Turbo, right?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo! Is it true that Tokai Teio
might not make it in time for the Triple Crown?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah... were you worried about me?
Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Seems like there are
some people saying things like that.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
True, if we want to play it safe,
it'd be best to win at least one soon...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: “I see... Then you're just like Turbo. The 'did everything you could, but nothing worked' club...”

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I know how you feel. So what're you gonna do?
Give up on spring and play with Turbo instead?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh... Give up, you say...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah ha ha ha! What are you saying?
I've never even thought of such a thing.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!?
You haven't given up hope yet?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Losing hope?
I don't even get what that's supposed to mean in the first place."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No matter what happens, I'm going to become a Triple Crown Umamusume!
That's the only thing I'm aiming for, and anything else is out of the question.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Even if hundreds or thousands of unexpected things happen,
nothing's gonna stop my dream!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Dreams... cannot be stopped...?
Tokai... Teio...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Trainer, Trainer, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As I was eavesdropping on the conversation,
that stray bullet came flying straight at me."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
You truly are amazing!
My lifelong rival!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio hasn't given up at all!
Giving up doesn't even make sense to her!
choice_data_list: Yeah, as expected of our shining star of hope.
Yeah, as expected of our star of hope.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her talent isn't the only thing that's wonderful. She is truly a bundle of positivity.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There was not a single trace of doubt in those eyes.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo wants to be one too, I wanna be one!
A star of hope! An explosive superstar!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Because Turbo and Teio are
lifelong rivals!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A burning rival spirit. In that case, if I stimulate that—
choice_data_list: Can you really call yourself a rival if you stay moping around?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Staying down in the dumps like this...
U-Uuuugh, that's just~..."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I can't say it~~~!!!
'Cause right now, Turbo is losing to Teio!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Turbo will do it!
I'll hang in there and keep up with everyone one more time!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: So let's train, train!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All right, one more time!
Turbo Engine at full throttleee!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inspired by Tokai Teio's never-give-up attitude,
the fire was rekindled in Twin Turbo's
heart once again.
